office_does: A State Representative writes and votes on Washington state law and the operating, capital and transportation budgets, covering taxes, school funding, public safety and natural-resource rules.
race_blurb: Republican Rep. Joe Schmick, a former farmer in office since 2007, faces Democrat Karina Wallace, a peer support specialist making her first run for office. Schmick took 61.6% in the primary; the race contrasts his fiscal-restraint record with her lobbying-reform and worker-protection platform.

candidates.summary: Republican incumbent since 2007 and former second-generation farmer, running on curbing state spending, agriculture and water, and parental involvement in schools.
highlights: Voted against the 2026 tax on income over $1 million and the 2025 capital-gains/estate and B&O tax increases [S5][S6]
Says 'We don't have a revenue problem, we have a spending problem' [S2]
Wants more local school-board control and parents informed of what is taught; voted against ESHB 1296 [S2][S8]

taxes.basis: Nay on ESSB 6346, SB 5813 and HB 2081, and campaigns on tax relief and 'a spending problem', not a revenue problem.

spending.basis: Calls for curbing state spending and living within means, and voted against the 2025-27 operating budget.

safety.basis: Says Democratic police reforms made communities less safe and police need more tools and support; no detail on treatment or diversion.

parental-rights.basis: Campaign plank that parents have a right to know what is taught in class, plus Nay on ESHB 1296 (amendments narrowing the I-2081 parental-rights list).

candidates.summary: Democrat and certified peer support specialist from Cheney, a first-time candidate running on paycheck protection, rural healthcare access and lobbying reform.
highlights: Refuses corporate PAC money and lobbyist donations [S1]
Wants stronger lobbying disclosure and closed gift loopholes [S2]
Supports legal immigration pathways, due process and humane treatment [S2]
Endorsed by the Washington State Labor Council and Spokane Regional Labor Council [S2]

reform.basis: Refuses corporate PAC and lobbyist money and proposes lobbying disclosure and gift-loophole limits.

immigration.basis: Supports due process and humane treatment and says fear-based enforcement does not make communities safer; also backs 'orderly legal immigration pathways'.

experience.basis: First-time candidate who describes herself as 'not a career politician'.
